title: preview surface follows clip aspect ratio

commit.merge_subject: merge: preview surface follows clip aspect ratio

description:
Owner finding 2026-11-10: the clip editor preview was a fixed box
filling whatever vertical space the column had left; it must match
the clip's own aspect ratio instead ("video 4:3, 16:9 olabilir...
sanki fixed bir box var").

The preview rendering (image, placeholder, access-lost, error
states) is extracted from ClipEditorScreen into the new
ui/editor/PreviewSurface.kt. The surface is fillMaxWidth with
Modifier.aspectRatio(w/h) driven by a pure, JVM-tested fallback
chain (PreviewSurfaceRatio.of):

  1. the current rendered PreviewFrame dims (already rotated
     upright by the renderer, used as-is) when present;
  2. else the persisted MediaSource width/height from the import
     stats, so even the pre-first-frame placeholder has the right
     shape;
  3. else 16:9.

Half-known or non-positive pairs count as unknown and are skipped.
Inside the shaped surface the bitmap renders with Co
